Truly one of the most insane voices I have ever heard. And she's actually back on Broadway in six. Now she is playing Jane Seymour, and her heart of stone is definitive. Go see it. Now, all seven of the young adults are actually making their Broadway debut in the show, and they're all giving great performances.
